Check whether a log level is enabled

Source: R/standalone_logger.R
isLoggingEnabled.Rd

Determine whether messages with the specified log level should be emitted based on the current application minimum log level stored in the RPACT_CLOUD_LOG_LEVEL environment variable. The comparison is performed case-insensitively. The special level "disabled" always returns FALSE and the alias "time" is treated as "info".

Usage

isLoggingEnabled(logLevel)

Arguments

logLevel

Character scalar indicating the log level to test. Supported values include "trace", "debug", "info", "warning", "error", "time" and "disabled".

Value

Logical scalar: TRUE if messages at the given level should be logged, FALSE otherwise.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
setAppLogLevel("warn")
isLoggingEnabled("info")
isLoggingEnabled("error")
} # }
